name: branding-motion-blur-runner-with-wave-wordmark
title: Fitness brand cover: cream wordmark with wave m over a motion-blurred forest runner
whatItIs: A green forest photograph blurred sideways with a trail runner sharp in the middle. A large cream lowercase 'tempo' overlays it, with the m and p connected by a wave line and a registered mark. A three-line tagline and '2026' pill sit at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Fluid, calm and athletic; the wave in the m visualises rhythm and pace.
techniques: Use directional motion blur in the background to imply speed.
Put a light lowercase wordmark on the image with a single distinctive letter modification.
Keep text small and centred beneath.
Use a natural muted green palette.

vocabulary.definition: A streak effect that suggests movement.
A logo set in all lowercase letters.
A cover where a photo carries the mood.
